updateCadence: A couple of releases per year; 2.53.24 beta Jul 5, final Jul 28 2026
summary: The community continuation of the Mozilla Application Suite: browser, mail/news, address book, ChatZilla IRC, and Composer in one app on an old Gecko 60 base. Still maintained but struggles with modern sites.
bestFor: Users who want an integrated browser, mail, IRC and HTML editor
Fans of the classic Netscape/Mozilla suite
notFor: Anyone relying on modern web apps

pros.title: True all-in-one suite
pros.detail: Browser, mail/newsgroups, RSS, ChatZilla IRC, address book and Composer in one install.

pros.title: Highly configurable
pros.detail: Modern and Classic skins plus legacy add-on support.

cons.title: Old Gecko base
cons.detail: Built on Firefox 60-era Gecko; the project admits many sites break because they require the latest Chrome or Firefox.

cons.title: Security debt
cons.detail: No modern sandbox or site isolation; backports are limited.

cons.title: Fewer platforms
cons.detail: x64 only now; Windows 7 x64+, macOS x64 and Linux x64.

cons.title: Small team
cons.detail: A release slipped two weeks in 2026 due to infrastructure moving from Azure to OSUOSL.

faq.a: Yes. 2.53.24 was released on 2026-07-28 and 2.53.23 earlier in 2026.
No. 2.53.21 was the last release with 32-bit Windows and Linux builds.
The 2.53.24 release page says Windows 7 x64 and higher; Wikipedia said 2.53.23 was the last for Win 7/8, so there is a discrepancy.

timeline.event: Last release with 32-bit Windows/Linux builds (date unverified)

switching.note: Imports Thunderbird/Firefox/Netscape profile data; add-ons must be legacy-compatible.

spec.codecs: Gecko 60 era (H.264 via system libs, VP9)
spec.sandbox: Gecko 60 content sandbox limited; no Fission
spec.patchLag: Years behind Mozilla; backports by volunteers

jsSpeed: Gecko 60 SpiderMonkey, far behind current engines
securityHardening: Old Gecko, no Fission or modern sandbox
patchSpeed: Volunteer backports to Gecko 60; years behind Mozilla
extras: Mail, news, IRC, Composer in one suite
webCompat: Gecko 60 base; project says many sites break on old engines
longevity: Still releasing but old base and small team

featureNotes.customThemes: Modern and Classic skins plus themes
